question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：苏格兰 vs 巴西（2026-06-24，90 分钟赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Scotland vs Brazil (2026-06-24, 90-minute result)
one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 209 分叠加苏格兰中场核心吉尔莫尔伤退、巴西阵容深度完整且内马尔预计小组赛内复出，巴西约六成胜率。
one_liner_en: A 209-point Elo gap, Scotland losing midfield hub Billy Gilmour, and Brazil's deep squad with Neymar expected back during the group stage give Brazil roughly a 60% win probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力差巨大：巴西 1991（第 5）对苏格兰 1782（第 26），Davidson 统计模型给巴西 59.4% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: Large Elo gap: Brazil 1991 (#5) vs Scotland 1782 (#26); the Davidson model gives Brazil a 59.4% baseline win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 苏格兰中场核心吉尔莫尔膝伤退出世界杯，由弗莱彻递补；前锋亚当斯大腿伤势成疑。
key_reasons.en: Scotland's midfield hub Billy Gilmour is out of the World Cup with a knee injury (Tyler Fletcher called up); striker Che Adams is a thigh-injury doubt.

key_reasons.cn: 内马尔 2 级肌肉拉伤预计缺席 2-3 周，但安切洛蒂预期其小组赛内复出；巴西其余主力齐整、阵容深度极强。
key_reasons.en: Neymar's grade 2 muscle strain sidelines him 2-3 weeks, but Ancelotti expects him back during the group stage; the rest of Brazil's squad is intact and very deep.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 0.178/0.228/0.594; bounded evidence adjustment (Scotland -2.0pp injuries, Brazil +1.5pp depth/Neymar return, draw +0.5pp rotation scenario; |delta| ~4pp of max 8pp) -> p_final 0.158/0.233/0.609. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.
